Chart_title: Compute capacity of the world's largest AI data centers, 2023–2030
What_the_chart_shows:
Compute capacity across the AI data centers Epoch tracks, stacked by owner, with observed history separated from projected build-out.
Note — Coverage is ~27% of AI compute delivered globally, so this is a floor; everything past the snapshot is an announced schedule, not a measurement
Methodology_reference:
Epoch AI data centers documentation
Site-level cumulative snapshots, step-summed across sites

Chart_title: IT power of the world's largest AI data centers, 2023–2030
What_the_chart_shows:
Installed IT power across the same sites, stacked by owner.
Note — IT power is the computing load only, not the facility total, and is largely inferred from cooling equipment seen in satellite imagery
Methodology_reference:
Epoch AI data centers documentation
Site-level cumulative snapshots, step-summed across sites

Chart_title: Capital cost of the world's largest AI data centers, 2023–2030
What_the_chart_shows:
Cumulative capital cost of the tracked sites in 2025 US dollars, stacked by owner.
Note — Cost is modelled from IT power using Epoch's cost-per-watt model; it is not drawn from company filings
Methodology_reference:
Epoch AI data centers documentation
Cost-per-watt model applied to IT power

Chart_title: Accelerator mix across tracked AI data centers, 2023–2030
What_the_chart_shows:
How many accelerators of each type are installed at the sites where Epoch records a chip breakdown.
Note — Units are counted, not performance-weighted, and only 16 of 219 chip records are company disclosures
Methodology_reference:
Epoch AI data centers documentation
Cumulative per-site chip counts, step-summed
Granularity: Site and chip-type level cumulative counts, aggregated quarterly

Chart_title: Cooling hardware size predicts its capacity, and so a site's power
What_the_chart_shows:
Rated cooling capacity against physical footprint for every unit in Epoch's cooling tower and chiller reference tables — the relationship that turns satellite imagery into a power estimate.
Note — Manufacturer catalogue ratings, not measurements of installed units; rated capacity is an upper bound
Methodology_reference:
Epoch AI data centers documentation
Cooling equipment reference tables
Granularity: One row per equipment model in the reference catalogue
